scope.summary: Implement original base mesh asset ingest per Section 13.16 (BK-16.5 base mesh/topology contract/license law): load the commissioned/original watertight quad-dominant base body mesh as a versioned artifact validated against the topology contract on ingest. The one-time MakeHuman CC0 GUI-export bootstrap reference is the ONLY permitted external lineage (license-verified CC0); SMPL-family and Genesis-derived payloads are prohibited inputs refused at this boundary (05-daz license findings).
acceptance_criteria: ingest_base_mesh(path, license_tag, version) loads OBJ/glTF geometry into a typed BaseMesh (mm vertices, quad-dominant face list, UV set refs), assigns a versioned artifact id, and persists via guarded bodykit storage with a tailor.body ledger event.
Ingest runs the MT-485 topology contract validator and fails closed (no row written) when the contract fails; rejection is BodyKitError::TopologyContract with per-check findings.

Ingest requires an explicit license_tag; 'makehuman_cc0_bootstrap' is accepted for the one-time reference import, SMPL/Genesis/dhdm lineage tags are rejected (enforced via the MT-488 guard once it lands; ingest calls the guard hook).
Vertex count, face count, and a content hash persist with the version so every later morph asset can assert the exact base mesh version it was authored against.
scope.risk_if_missed: An unversioned or unvalidated base mesh leaves every morph delta unanchored (vertex-order drift corrupts all channels — the Daz unimesh lesson), and a lineage slip here poisons the commercial adult product legally: SMPL's license prohibits pornographic use outright.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
